resources.string: Drydock runs a complete Linux environment on your phone; AI coding agents live here and work for you anytime.
Configure the battery whitelist once and tasks continue after screen-off.
OpenCode, pi and other common agents — pick and install.
Files generated by agents are visible in the system file manager.
✓ Background run allowed\nTasks keep working with the screen off
Drydock needs permission to keep running after screen-off — this is what makes unattended work possible; otherwise tasks get suspended. This step cannot be skipped.
Xiaomi HyperOS: if the standard dialog does not work, go to System settings → App info → Battery saver and pick "No restrictions", then come back and refresh.
Connect agents to a model: for common services just paste a key, or fill in a custom endpoint. You can also skip this for now.
Get the key from the provider\'s console. After saving it is written to an environment variable (~/.drydock/env.sh), takes effect in new sessions, and is auto-detected by agents — no further setup.
① Pick a protocol (the chat format; a wrong one will not connect)
API root of the service, from the provider\'s docs; usually ends with /v1 or /v4, without /chat/completions
A model the service actually offers, copy from the docs (e.g. glm-5.3-flash, deepseek-chat)

Fill both from the provider\'s docs: context window = how much the model can read at once; max output = how much it can generate per turn (many services need this explicitly; leave empty for tool defaults).
Saved as "export VAR=key" into ~/.drydock/env.sh; leave empty to write config only and add the key later
Identifier of this endpoint in config files: models show as "provider/model"; does not affect connection. Leave empty to derive from the domain; adding the same name again overwrites
To change the key later: edit ~/.drydock/env.sh (Settings → Environment variables); config files stay untouched.
We preinstall a few agents for you to download. You can pick several, or none (install later).
Coding agent with a browser UI
Setup complete. Open a terminal to start; for later personalization (startup files, shell environment) just ask the agent.
